chars.SUITOR: a Moroccan man in his mid-thirties with slicked-back black hair and a short trimmed beard, wearing a cream linen suit, open-collar black shirt, big gold watch
chars.SISTER: a young Moroccan woman in her twenties with long dark curly hair, wearing an emerald green satin blouse and gold hoop earrings
chars.MOTHER: a Moroccan woman in her fifties wearing a burgundy djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.BROTHER: a young Moroccan man in his early twenties with a short fade haircut, wearing a grey hoodie and black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from inside a Moroccan apartment hallway looking at the open front door in bright morning light: SUITOR stands in the doorway mid-step, smiling confidently, arms full with a huge bouquet of red roses and a big decorated box of luxury dates, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, Casablanca apartment stairwell behind him. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SUITOR walks straight into a traditional Moroccan salon with colourful sedari sofas without waiting to be invited, while MOTHER stands frozen in surprise holding the door handle, eyebrows raised. Morning light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon, BROTHER and MOTHER exchange a suspicious look side by side, whispering, BROTHER frowning with arms crossed, a closed curtain doorway behind them. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SUITOR places expensive gifts on a low Moroccan table: a giant box of chocolates, luxury dates on a silver tray, a big bouquet of roses; SISTER sits shyly on the sofa smiling, the gifts piled like for a wedding. 2D animated cartoon style.
